subject: Model mix & pricing qualification - BrightLayer
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>

Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Model mix & pricing qualification - BrightLayer

Thanks for the time today — great conversation. Quick recap + next steps so we have everything in one place.

Call recap:
- Use cases: customer support triage (chat summaries + suggestions), semantic search for docs (embeddings + similarity), and content moderation/reranking for suggested responses.
- Latency: customer-facing chat needs ~ <300ms p95 for short prompts; embeddings can be async/batched.
- Security: data residency in us-west required; SOC2 evidence requested (we can provide).

Open items we need to size pricing and next steps:
1) Monthly token volumes per model type (approx): chat prompts & responses, embeddings (number of vectors / requests), rerank calls. An order-of-magnitude estimate is fine.
2) Target budget range and target $/1M tokens you're aiming for (helps me propose model mix + discounts).
3) Any hard SLOs or throughput peaks we should account for.

Attached a simple token-estimates template (brightlayer_token_estimates.xlsx) — if you can drop rough numbers in there I'll run a blended pricing calc and share a one-pager.

Next steps:
- You fill the token estimates sheet (or reply here with rough numbers) — Marissa to return blended unit economics and a sample pricing proposal.
- If numbers look aligned, schedule a short follow-up (30m) to review canary plan + DA/contracting.

Thanks — looking forward to aligning.

--
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0198

From: Alyssa Turner <alyssa@brightlayer.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Nguyen <tom@brightlayer.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Mar 2026 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Model mix & pricing qualification - BrightLayer

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the clear recap. Quick answers / rough estimates below (we'll also fill the sheet this afternoon):

Estimated monthly activity (order-of-magnitude):
- Chat (customer support): ~120M input tokens (prompts) + ~360M output tokens (responses) => ~480M tokens/month
- Embeddings (semantic search): ~1.2M embedding requests/month, average 768 tokens per document processed => ~900M tokens/month equivalent (we measure embeddings by calls but included token-equivalent for cost calc)
- Rerank (batch rerank of candidate responses): ~12M tokens/month

Rough per-model split (by token volume):
- Chat: ~35%
- Embeddings: ~55%
- Rerank: ~10%

Budget: We're targeting a monthly SaaS budget in the $50k–$80k range to start. For procurement we need to see unit economics expressed as $/1M tokens so we can baseline across vendors — target internal benchmark is ~$200–$300 per 1M tokens blended across our expected model mix.

Questions for you:
- Can you provide blended price examples at both hosted and dedicated tiers (we may look at reserved if performance/cost align)?
- Do you support per-model quantization or cheaper variants (e.g., 8-bit) that preserve our latency SLOs?

I'll upload the estimates in the sheet and flag any clarifications. Happy to hop on a short call if you want to walk through the numbers together.

Thanks,
Alyssa
Alyssa Turner
Head of Automation, BrightLayer
alyssa@brightlayer.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Turner <alyssa@brightlayer.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 3 Mar 2026 10:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Model mix & pricing qualification - BrightLayer

Thanks Alyssa — this is exactly the level of detail we need, appreciate it. I pulled together a quick blended unit-economics example based on the splits you provided and two pricing scenarios (hosted vs reserved/dedicated). See attached one-pager (redwood_pricing_proposal_1M_tokens.pdf) and a shared drive copy: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C4dBrightLayerPricing

Blended examples (summary):
- Assumptions: chat=35%, embeddings=55%, rerank=10% (by token volume).
- Target blended $/1M tokens (your benchmark): $200–$300.

Scenario A — Hosted (pay-as-you-go, sample list prices before volume discounts):
- Blended estimate: $260 / 1M tokens (predicted at your volume, single-tenant discounts possible).
- Pros: fastest time-to-value, no infra commitments; Cons: less predictable unit cost at high peaks.

Scenario B — Dedicated/Reserved (monthly commit for capacity):
- Blended estimate: $180 / 1M tokens (with a 6–12 month commit and model-mix pins).
- Pros: predictable unit economics, SLA-backed latency; Cons: commitment required, provisioning lead time.

Model recommendations to hit your $200–$300 target:
- Chat: start with a higher-accuracy chat model for the customer-facing flows; for lower-criticality system prompts we can use a cheaper variant. We can also enable KV/prefix caching for typical support flows to reduce tokens.
- Embeddings: use quantized embedding models for bulk indexing to lower cost; we can surface higher-dim embeddings for re-rank when needed.
- Rerank: run as batched jobs using cheaper model variants where latency is less strict.

Next steps I propose:
1) I'll update the attached proposal with the numbers once you upload the sheet.
2) If the dedicated numbers look good, let's put together a mutual action plan (scope, commit, SLOs) and loop in contracts/procurement.
3) Schedule a 30m follow-up — I have Tue 3/4 11:00am PT and Wed 3/5 9:30am PT open. Which works for you?

Attachment: redwood_pricing_proposal_1M_tokens.pdf (one-pager with blended calc and scenarios)
